joint_results.title: C1 literal integral models, weights and commuting maps
worked_manual_attack: Expanded the Semaev f3 specialization A=-1,B=1 on paper and compared every listed g1/g2 coefficient. For g2, the two mixed u*x3 terms cancel, leaving the eight literal terms stated in the protocol. The curve discriminant -368 and geometric exclusion set {2,3,23} are consistent; integer certificates retain those primes.

At free_u,D=2 the source has no chain-generator multipliers, three membership columns, all 15 ordinary monomials, and 12 normal monomials. A_rel(a,b,c)=a(e14-e4)+b(e10-e3)+c(e7-e2). Substituting these coordinates gives qA_rel=0, LA_rel=I, qj=I and A_rel L+jq=I without assuming the target identities.

Traced the telescoping identity z^a-z=(z^2-z)(1+...+z^(a-2)). Each multiplier has degree at most D-2; coefficient reduction preserves the integral identities. q is the idempotent normal-form map; rho preserves the fixed generator weight and has section iota. Thus B_full=B_red rho is a stated concrete entrywise obligation, with coker inverse induced by j, since j q A_chain=A_chain-A_rel L A_chain.

Dropping the zero constant coordinate at D=2 changes P_D and its cokernel, so the full-basis requirement detects it. Reweighting the bit_u reduction of g2 from its fixed weight 4 to its actual reduced degree 2 would introduce a generator row at D=2 where the frozen chain domain is zero. The protocol explicitly rejects this presentation change.

At (x1,x2,x3,u)=(0,1,0,-1), g1=1+2-3=0 and g2=1+2-3=0, leaf membership vanishes, and u^2-u=2. This separates the integral free_u and bit_u ideals over Q and odd primes. It gives no characteristic-2 separation by itself; the protocol does not use it for that. Adding u^p-u changes the free-u presentation even though every Fp-valued point satisfies it.
joint_results.reason: The fixed integer coefficient models, complete bases, weights and explicit quotient/specialization maps are sufficient protocol definitions. Cokernel isomorphism is justified by concrete split maps; equality of kernel embeddings, Boolean Weil descent, rational-point recovery and arbitrary digit transfer are explicitly excluded.
later_execution_prerequisites: Independently reconstruct every A, A_rel, A_chain, q, j, L, B_full, rho, iota and B_red for all 14 cells, including zero shapes and degree witnesses.
Retain actual polynomial degree, quotient degree and frozen presentation weight separately.

joint_results.title: C2 rank, determinantal, Smith and kernel-basechange completeness
worked_manual_attack: A nonzero selected r-minor gives only a lower bound. The separate exact A=C R factorization bounds rank over Q; therefore all larger integer minors vanish, even at primes dividing factor denominators. No reduction of a rational factorization at such a prime is assumed.

For A=[2,3], the lexicographic witness minor is 2 but gcd(2,3)=1. The integer matrix V with columns (-1,1) and (-3,2) has determinant 1 and A V=[1,0]. Hence E_cons={2}, E_exact is empty, and the primitive integer kernel is generated by (-3,2). The contract rejects selected-minor exactness and retains the false-positive candidate.

For diag(1,2), Q-rank is 2 and F2-rank is 1; the extra modular vector e2 connects by A e2/2=e2 to the nonzero cokernel class. For diag(1,4), the same F2 rank and exception support occur, but the class generator has order 4 and e2 connects to [2e2], an order-2 class. The protocol retains both invariant factors and valuations.

For diag(2,2) versus diag(1,4), total torsion order and exception support coincide while the F2 ranks and counts of new classes differ. For diag(3,3) versus diag(1,9) the analogous distinction is at 3. For diag(1,0), doubling the free kernel vector e2 gives a nonprimitive sublattice, not torsion; full integer inverses of V prevent this incomplete basis from being accepted.

Applied the two short exact sequences to K=ker A, I=im A and C=coker A. I is a free Z-module, so K/pK injects into the modular domain; the remaining kernel is Tor_1(C,Fp)=C[p]. For a lift v of a modular kernel vector, Av/p is integral and changing v by pz changes its class by Az. The stated V-basis realizes all directions and the lifting criterion. This is manual protocol reasoning, not a completed rank/SNF computation.

Checked column-map indexing against the primary sources: A is m by n as Z^n to Z^m, coker has free rank m-r, and Fitt_(m-k)=I_k(A). Stanley uses a row-cokernel convention and his displayed rectangular summand notation is not blindly imported; the protocol obtains its dimension-correct formula directly from full rectangular UAV=S and both integer inverse identities. Stacks presentation indexing supports the stated convention.
joint_results.reason: Full integer Smith equivalence, canonical divisibility, all determinantal divisors and complete deterministic factorization make the exact exceptional set a certificate consequence. The kernel/Tor and prime-power statements use the correct modules and maps. Rank-zero, empty and rectangular cases are explicitly defined.
